question: Vaijayantimala, a famous Indian actress, was also an exponent of which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __Bharatanatyam.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vyjayantimala Bali is mainly associated with Bharatanatyam.
 
• Vyjayanthimala is a former Indian actress, dancer, and parliamentarian. Regarded as the “First Female Superstar” of Hindi cinema, she is the recipient of several awards.
 
• Bharatnatyam is the oldest Indian classical dance.
 
 
• It originated hundreds of years ago in the state of Tamilnadu.
 
• This dance form expresses the religious themes and spiritual ideas of South India.
 
• The ancient Tamil epic Silappatikaram contains the description of Bharatnatyam.
